s: Minhag akilat tzali belel pesach ubo z' seipim: maqom shennahagu leekol basar tzali belel pesach — okelin. Maqom shennahagu shello leekol, mishshum gezera shemma yomru pesach hu — asur lahem leshannot minhagam. Veap benehem acharehem enan rashshain leshannot minhag abotehem. Veap mi shebba ladur sham mimmaqom shennahagu leekol — asur lo leekol, ayyen siman ts"ch. Ubimdinot ellu nahagu shello leekol:

Ubekol maqom asur leekol belayla zeh gedayim hamqullasin (perush "mequllas" hu leshon mezuyyan, shekkeraayv ubene meayv bishat tzeliyyato hen teluyin lemala merosho o mitztziddo kegibbor mezuyyan shekkoba nechoshet lemala merosho ukele zeno betziddo), dehaynu gedi o kebes tzaluy kullo keechad ("rosho al keraayv veal qirbo"), velo nechsar mimmennu shum eber, shehare zeh domeh litzliyyat happesach, shehaya nitzla keshehu shalem kullo keechad (ukeraayv ubene meayv teluyin chutza lo), vihe nireh keokel pesach bachutz. Abal im tzala oto keshehu mechuttak, o apillu keshehu mechubbar ella shennechtak eber echad miggupo qodem hatztzeliyya, o sheshshalaq bo eber echad keshehu mechubbar veachar kak tzala oto kullo keechad, hoil veeno domeh litzliyyat happesach — hare zeh muttar bemaqom shennahagu leekol tzali belayla zeh:

Apillu besar egel veop sheen happesach ba mehem, veken kol dabar hattaun shechita — asur leoklo tzali bemaqom shennahagu shello leekol, lepi shehaolam yitu ben tzali letzali veyabou lehattir gam basar tzaluy mikkebasim veizzim, kevan shehakkol min basar, abal dabar sheeno taun shechita, kegon dagim ubetzim — muttar leoklam tzeluyim, lepi sheenan domin kelal lebasar velo yitu bahem:

Tzeli qedar (perush shennitzla biqdera belo mayim veshum mashqeh, ella mitbashshel bammohal hayyotze mimmennu), ap al pi sheeno domeh litzliyyat happesach, shehappesach shennitzla biqdera pasul, ap al pi ken bemaqom shennahagu shello leekol tzali — yesh leosro mippene marit haayin, shello yitu lehattir gam tzeli esh. Vaapillu im bishshelo mittechilla bemayim veachar kak asao tzeli qedar — yesh leesor mittaam zeh. Umikkol maqom, letzorek choleh qetzat yesh lehaqel bazeh, ki yesh mi shemmattir tzeli qedar. Abal im tzelao apillu tzeli esh veachar kak bishshelo — muttar, lepi shehabbishshul mebattel et hatztzeliyya, vekayyotze bazeh bepesach pasul:

Yesh lizzaher shello leekol velo lishtot bisuda zo harbeh yoter midday, shello yokal haapiqoman baakila gassa, dehaynu sheeno taeb kelal leekol, sheaz eno oseh [mitzva] min hammubchar, sheap shehaapiqoman hu zeker lappesach vehappesach haya neekal al hassoba, dehaynu shehu sabea kebar, velaken okelin haapiqoman achar gemar kol hasseuda kemo sheyyitbaer besiman ta"z, mikkol maqom tzarik sheyyehe lo qetzat taava leekol, abal kesheeno mitavveh kelal veokel — hare zo akila gassa, veen zo mitzva min hammubchar. Abal mikkol maqom yotze yede chobato baakila zo. Abal im saba kol kak ad shennapsho qatza baakila merob sobo, ap sheddocheq et atzmo leekol — eno yotze yede chobato baakila zo, sheakila gassa kazo enah niqret akila kelal, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman try"b:

Nohagin biqtzat meqomot leekol betzim basseuda zeker laabelut churban bet hammiqdash, shekkeshehaya qayyam hayu maqribin pesach veokelin belayla zeh, veakshav en lanu pesach laken mitabbelin akshav al zeh. Umizzeh hattaam okelin betzim gam ballayla hashsheni:

Yesh nohagin shello leekol belayla zeh shum tibbul raq shene tibbulim ellu, dehaynu tibbul harishon sheqqodem amirat hahaggada, vetibbul hammaror bacharoset, kede sheyyehe nikkar sheshshene tibbulim ellu hem leshem mitzva:
